2. **Last candidate trade-off**: Better lockbox min (robustness) but worse tuning min (0.05 is near-zero on one fold) and deeper drawdown

```bash
  --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level candidate testing
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate next fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Focus Areas for Next Cycle

- **Fold stability**: Tuning min of 0.05 on candidate suggests fragility—investigate fold 14 specifically
- **MDD constraint**: Both configs near -10% MDD; consider tightening risk bounds in next experiments
